name: @papercusp/fanout-resolver
description: A generic, pure generative fan-out core. Resolve a fan-out spec (inline items / file-glob / SQL query — runners injected; or a `deferred` set produced later by an upstream producer) to a deduped, trimmed, capped item list, then expand a list into N deterministic-id children. Zero I/O, zero domain coupling — glob/SQL runners are injected; over-cap fan-out and resolver failures throw (FanoutCapError / FanoutResolverError) rather than silently truncating or yielding zero.
